name: Proxmox VE
description: Typed Proxmox VE cluster, guest, storage, snapshot, backup, network and task operations with guarded writes and explicit task inspection.

permissions.description: HTTPS to the explicit Proxmox VE endpoint using an explicitly named encrypted API-token secret or the host-selected $connection RuntimeConnection API-key credential. Profiles supply public endpoint/tokenId configuration and may bind an explicit tokenSecret alias. No ticket login, ambient credentials, TLS bypass, internal retries or autonomous polling.

definitions.name: Get Proxmox VE Version (Direct)
definitions.description: Get Proxmox VE Version
definitions.documentation:
Get Proxmox VE Version. GET /version. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Read only. Lists are bounded; task/log offsets are explicit and other collection endpoints have no invented pagination. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

definitions.name: List Cluster Resources (Direct)
definitions.description: List Cluster Resources
definitions.documentation:
List Cluster Resources. GET /cluster/resources. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Read only. Lists are bounded; task/log offsets are explicit and other collection endpoints have no invented pagination. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

definitions.name: Get Node Status (Direct)
definitions.description: Get Node Status
definitions.documentation:
Get Node Status. GET /nodes/{node}/status. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Read only. Lists are bounded; task/log offsets are explicit and other collection endpoints have no invented pagination. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

definitions.description: List Node Tasks
definitions.documentation:
List Node Tasks. GET /nodes/{node}/tasks. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Read only. Lists are bounded; task/log offsets are explicit and other collection endpoints have no invented pagination. definitions.description: Stop Task
definitions.documentation:
Stop Task. DELETE /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Requires confirmWrites=true, explicit $retries=0 and exact request.confirmation=task-stop. UPID acceptance is separate from completion; inspect Task Status and Task Log manually. No automatic replay. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

definitions.name: List QEMU VMs (Direct)
definitions.description: List QEMU VMs
definitions.documentation:
List QEMU VMs. GET /nodes/{node}/qemu. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Read only. Lists are bounded; task/log offsets are explicit and other collection endpoints have no invented pagination. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

definitions.name: Update QEMU VM Config (Direct)
definitions.description: Update QEMU VM Config
definitions.documentation:
Update QEMU VM Config. PUT /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/config. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Requires confirmWrites=true, explicit $retries=0 and exact request.confirmation=qemu-config-update. UPID acceptance is separate from completion; inspect Task Status and Task Log manually. No automatic replay. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

definitions.description: Create QEMU VM
definitions.documentation:
Create QEMU VM. POST /nodes/{node}/qemu. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Requires confirmWrites=true, explicit $retries=0 and exact request.confirmation=qemu-create. UPID acceptance is separate from completion; inspect Task Status and Task Log manually. No automatic replay. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

Delete QEMU VM. DELETE /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Requires confirmWrites=true, explicit $retries=0 and exact request.confirmation=qemu-delete. UPID acceptance is separate from completion; inspect Task Status and Task Log manually. No automatic replay. definitions.name: QEMU VM shutdown (Direct)
definitions.description: QEMU VM shutdown
definitions.documentation:
QEMU VM shutdown. POST /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/status/shutdown. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Requires confirmWrites=true, explicit $retries=0 and exact request.confirmation=qemu-shutdown. UPID acceptance is separate from completion; inspect Task Status and Task Log manually. No automatic replay. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

definitions.name: QEMU VM reboot (Direct)
definitions.description: QEMU VM reboot
definitions.documentation:
QEMU VM reboot. POST /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/status/reboot. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Requires confirmWrites=true, explicit $retries=0 and exact request.confirmation=qemu-reboot. UPID acceptance is separate from completion; inspect Task Status and Task Log manually. No automatic replay. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

definitions.name: QEMU VM resume (Direct)
definitions.description: QEMU VM resume
definitions.documentation:
QEMU VM resume. POST /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/status/resume. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Requires confirmWrites=true, explicit $retries=0 and exact request.confirmation=qemu-resume. UPID acceptance is separate from completion; inspect Task Status and Task Log manually. No automatic replay. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

definitions.name: Clone QEMU VM (Direct)
definitions.description: Clone QEMU VM
definitions.documentation:
Clone QEMU VM. POST /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/clone. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Requires confirmWrites=true, explicit $retries=0 and exact request.confirmation=qemu-clone. UPID acceptance is separate from completion; inspect Task Status and Task Log manually. No automatic replay. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

definitions.name: Migrate QEMU VM (Direct)
definitions.description: Migrate QEMU VM
definitions.documentation:
Migrate QEMU VM. POST /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/migrate. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Requires confirmWrites=true, explicit $retries=0 and exact request.confirmation=qemu-migrate. UPID acceptance is separate from completion; inspect Task Status and Task Log manually. No automatic replay. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

definitions.documentation:
Get QEMU VM Snapshot Config. GET /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/snapshot/{snapname}/config. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Read only. Lists are bounded; task/log offsets are explicit and other collection endpoints have no invented pagination. definitions.documentation:
Delete QEMU VM Snapshot. DELETE /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/snapshot/{snapname}. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Requires confirmWrites=true, explicit $retries=0 and exact request.confirmation=qemu-snapshot-delete. UPID acceptance is separate from completion; inspect Task Status and Task Log manually. No automatic replay. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

definitions.name: Rollback QEMU VM Snapshot (Direct)
definitions.description: Rollback QEMU VM Snapshot
definitions.documentation:
Rollback QEMU VM Snapshot. POST /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/snapshot/{snapname}/rollback. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Requires confirmWrites=true, explicit $retries=0 and exact request.confirmation=qemu-snapshot-rollback. UPID acceptance is separate from completion; inspect Task Status and Task Log manually. No automatic replay. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

definitions.description: List LXC Containers
definitions.documentation:
List LXC Containers. GET /nodes/{node}/lxc. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Read only. Lists are bounded; task/log offsets are explicit and other collection endpoints have no invented pagination. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

definitions.name: Update LXC Container Config (Direct)
definitions.description: Update LXC Container Config
definitions.documentation:
Update LXC Container Config. PUT /nodes/{node}/lxc/{vmid}/config. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Requires confirmWrites=true, explicit $retries=0 and exact request.confirmation=lxc-config-update. UPID acceptance is separate from completion; inspect Task Status and Task Log manually. No automatic replay. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

definitions.description: Create LXC Container
definitions.documentation:
Create LXC Container. POST /nodes/{node}/lxc. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Requires confirmWrites=true, explicit $retries=0 and exact request.confirmation=lxc-create. UPID acceptance is separate from completion; inspect Task Status and Task Log manually. No automatic replay. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

definitions.name: LXC Container stop (Direct)
definitions.description: LXC Container stop
definitions.documentation:
LXC Container stop. POST /nodes/{node}/lxc/{vmid}/status/stop. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Requires confirmWrites=true, explicit $retries=0 and exact request.confirmation=lxc-stop. UPID acceptance is separate from completion; inspect Task Status and Task Log manually. No automatic replay. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

definitions.description: LXC Container shutdown
definitions.documentation:
LXC Container shutdown. POST /nodes/{node}/lxc/{vmid}/status/shutdown. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Requires confirmWrites=true, explicit $retries=0 and exact request.confirmation=lxc-shutdown. UPID acceptance is separate from completion; inspect Task Status and Task Log manually. No automatic replay. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

definitions.description: Migrate LXC Container
definitions.documentation:
Migrate LXC Container. POST /nodes/{node}/lxc/{vmid}/migrate. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Requires confirmWrites=true, explicit $retries=0 and exact request.confirmation=lxc-migrate. UPID acceptance is separate from completion; inspect Task Status and Task Log manually. No automatic replay. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

definitions.documentation:
List LXC Container Snapshots. GET /nodes/{node}/lxc/{vmid}/snapshot. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Read only. Lists are bounded; task/log offsets are explicit and other collection endpoints have no invented pagination. definitions.name: Create LXC Container Snapshot (Direct)
definitions.description: Create LXC Container Snapshot
definitions.documentation:
Create LXC Container Snapshot. POST /nodes/{node}/lxc/{vmid}/snapshot. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Requires confirmWrites=true, explicit $retries=0 and exact request.confirmation=lxc-snapshot-create. UPID acceptance is separate from completion; inspect Task Status and Task Log manually. No automatic replay. definitions.name: Get LXC Container Snapshot Config (Direct)
definitions.description: Get LXC Container Snapshot Config
definitions.documentation:
Get LXC Container Snapshot Config. GET /nodes/{node}/lxc/{vmid}/snapshot/{snapname}/config. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Read only. Lists are bounded; task/log offsets are explicit and other collection endpoints have no invented pagination. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

Delete LXC Container Snapshot. DELETE /nodes/{node}/lxc/{vmid}/snapshot/{snapname}. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Requires confirmWrites=true, explicit $retries=0 and exact request.confirmation=lxc-snapshot-delete. UPID acceptance is separate from completion; inspect Task Status and Task Log manually. No automatic replay. List Node Storage. GET /nodes/{node}/storage. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Read only. Lists are bounded; task/log offsets are explicit and other collection endpoints have no invented pagination. definitions.name: Get Storage Status (Direct)
definitions.description: Get Storage Status
definitions.documentation:
Get Storage Status. GET /nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}/status. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Read only. Lists are bounded; task/log offsets are explicit and other collection endpoints have no invented pagination. definitions.name: List Storage Content (Direct)
definitions.description: List Storage Content
definitions.documentation:
List Storage Content. GET /nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}/content. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Read only. Lists are bounded; task/log offsets are explicit and other collection endpoints have no invented pagination. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

definitions.description: Create Guest Backup
definitions.documentation:
Create Guest Backup. POST /nodes/{node}/vzdump. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Requires confirmWrites=true, explicit $retries=0 and exact request.confirmation=backup-create. UPID acceptance is separate from completion; inspect Task Status and Task Log manually. No automatic replay. definitions.description: List Network Interfaces
definitions.documentation:
List Network Interfaces. GET /nodes/{node}/network. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Read only. Lists are bounded; task/log offsets are explicit and other collection endpoints have no invented pagination. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm

definitions.name: Get Network Interface (Direct)
definitions.description: Get Network Interface
definitions.documentation:
Get Network Interface. GET /nodes/{node}/network/{iface}. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Read only. Lists are bounded; task/log offsets are explicit and other collection endpoints have no invented pagination. definitions.name: Get Node DNS Configuration (Direct)
definitions.description: Get Node DNS Configuration
definitions.documentation:
Get Node DNS Configuration. GET /nodes/{node}/dns. Explicit encrypted API token secret plus token ID and HTTPS endpoint, or the host-selected $connection API-key RuntimeConnection with endpoint/tokenId in profile.config and the token in profile.credentials.apiKey. Profile config defaults and secret aliases follow the host's normal preparation; explicit tokenSecret takes precedence. Normal fetch TLS verification is mandatory; custom CA and insecure toggles are unsupported. One request, redirects rejected, 128 KiB form body, 1 MiB response, 100..30000 ms overall deadline, independently bounded 250 ms cleanup. Known selected fields only; provider extensions and credentials omitted. Provider numeric strings and 0/1 booleans normalize to named typed results. Read only. Lists are bounded; task/log offsets are explicit and other collection endpoints have no invented pagination. Sources: https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-viewer/index.html https://pve.proxmox.com/wiki/Proxmox_VE_API https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Cluster.pm https://github.com/proxmox/qemu-server/blob/master/src/PVE/API2/Qemu.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-container/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/LXC https://github.com/proxmox/pve-storage/tree/master/src/PVE/API2/Storage https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Tasks.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/Network.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-manager/blob/master/PVE/API2/VZDump.pm https://github.com/proxmox/pve-http-server/blob/master/src/PVE/APIServer/AnyEvent.pm
